# LLM context index for zero

Zero is a batteries-included web framework for the Zig language. It wires REST,
SQL, NoSQL, cache, pub/sub, auth, GraphQL, Protobuf, search, metrics and tracing
into one static binary, configured mostly through `.env`.

- Documentation: https://zerofmk.in
- Getting started: https://zerofmk.in/started
- Examples: https://zerofmk.in/examples
- Feature parity: https://zerofmk.in/parity
- Source: https://github.com/im-ng/zero

## Docs

- [Why Zero](https://zerofmk.in) — Go ergonomics without its runtime, Node speed without its footprint
- [Configuration](https://zerofmk.in/configuration) — `.env` with per-environment overrides
- [SQLite](https://zerofmk.in/sqlite) — embedded SQL backend
- [DuckDB](https://zerofmk.in/duckdb) — in-process OLAP
- [PostgreSQL](https://zerofmk.in) — primary SQL backend
- [Pub/Sub](https://zerofmk.in/pubsub) — MQTT, NATS, Kafka, Redis, SQS, GCP
- [Authentication](https://zerofmk.in/authentication) — Basic, API Key, OAuth 2.0
- [GraphQL](https://zerofmk.in/graphql) — schema-less resolvers over HTTP
- [Protobuf](https://zerofmk.in/protobuf) — proto3 bind/decode/encode
- [Cron](https://zerofmk.in/cronz) — second-level cron jobs
- [WebSocket](https://zerofmk.in/websocket) — inbound + outbound clients
- [Observability](https://zerofmk.in/observability) — Prometheus, tracing, structured logs
- [Rate Limiter](https://zerofmk.in/rate-limiter) — memory or Redis-backed
- [Resilience](https://zerofmk.in/resilience) — circuit breakers, timeouts, bulkheads
- [Migrations](https://zerofmk.in/migrations) — DB migrations + seed on startup
- [Kubernetes](https://zerofmk.in/kubernetes) — image build + manifests
- [Benchmark](https://zerofmk.in/benchmark) — reproducible throughput/latency/RSS runs

## Repo layout

- `src/` — framework source (datasources, pubsub, filestore, mw, service, cronz, migration)
- `examples/` — 30 runnable example apps (zero-basic, zero-sql, zero-auth, zero-kafka, ...)
- `AGENTS.md` — contributor + AI-agent guide (style, toolchain, verify gates)
- `.opencode/skills/zero-feature-runbook` — change runbook

## Install

```bash
zig fetch --save https://github.com/im-ng/zero/archive/refs/tags/v0.5.4.tar.gz
```
